text_block_list.text:
Having completed her Debut race, Ikuno 
Dictus truly savored the pure joy of 
running with all her heart.

After the race. Though you asked "IRON 
WILL" for its opinion, it only offers 
rigid, by-the-book suggestions. The AI 
simply hasn't learned enough yet.

If we feed it more data from actual races, 
it should become capable of offering 
flexible suggestions.

The next day, her Trainer proposes the G1 
Hanshin Juvenile Fillies as her next race, 
explaining that G1 experience is essential 
for the Tiara route.

Though Ikuno Dictus hesitated for a 
moment, she steeled her resolve. And so, 
the days leading up to the Hanshin JF 
began!
